spanish: Sobre tortas de pan de levadura acercará su ofrenda, sobre sacrificio: agradecimiento de sus ofrendas de paz.

findings.issue: The colon specifies absolute זֶבַח as תּוֹדַת; the morphology only juxtaposes an absolute noun with the following construct phrase.

notes: Construct chain, hiphil 3ms, and both 3ms suffixes match the Spanish.
